title: Getbackers Voice Comic Staff Apologizes for Generative AI Use in PR Video
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the voice comic of Yūya Aoki and Rando Ayamine 's Getbackers manga apologized to fans for the use of generative AI in a promotional video last week, and the resulting misunderstanding, confusion, and worry among fans. (The voice comic project adds an audio track for dialogue and sound effects to existing panels from the manga.)

The apology post explained that the video was only announcing the continuation of the voice comic, which had been on hiatus for almost 10 months. The post added that the use of generative AI in the video, and the lack of disclosure about how it was used, misled people into thinking that the manga would get a brand-new television anime, or at least that the manga would get a new anime that would use generative AI.

The voice comic's staff still plans to resume the project on December 1, and as with previous episodes, the staff still plans to combine the manga's panels with spoken dialogue by voice actors and sound effects.

The staff emphasizes that they do not plan to use generative AI for processing the source material in the voice comic, and do not plan to use generative AI for animation in the voice comic.

The voice comic's staff also emphasized that their management was entirely responsible for the use of generative AI in the announcement promotional video, and that manga's original publisher Kodansha played no role in that decision. The staff added that they will refrain from animating future announcement videos and promotional videos with generative AI that would cause similar misunderstandings. The staff will strengthen its vetting process on production content and presentation.

The manga follows the adventures of Ban and Ginji, two young men who hire themselves out to "get back" things that people have lost.

Aoki and Ayamine debuted the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in March 1999, and ended it in February 2007. The manga had 39 compiled book volumes. Tokyopop once published the manga before losing the rights in 2009.

The manga inspired a 49-episode anime series that premiered in 2002, with an American release by ADV Films following in 2004. Sentai Filmworks then licensed the anime.

Thank you to Kan2Screm for the news tip.
author: ANN

title: Jimoto no Ijimekko-tachi ni Shikaeshi Shiyō to Shitara Anime's Video Unveils Cast
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the television anime of Kengo Matsumoto 's Jimoto no Ijimekko-tachi ni Shikaeshi Shiyō to Shitara, Betsu no Tatakai ga Hajimatta. (When I Tried to Get Payback Against My Hometown Bullies, Another Battle Began) manga (nicknamed "Ijihaji" for short) announced the show's main four cast members over the last four days, and presented a promotional video on Tuesday.

The anime stars:

• Kaori Maeda as Akira Mikazuki, a wrestling genius (pictured at right in visual below)

• Yūko Natsuyoshi as Kanae Oborozuki, a basketball genius (center)

• Lynn as Shigure Mangetsu, a gaming master (left)

• Rikuya Yasuda as the protagonist Kotarō Hinode

The "new type of misunderstanding battle romantic comedy" manga centers on Kotarō Hinode, who when he was young was constantly humiliated in wrestling, basketball, and games by three children named Akira, Kanae, and Shigure, respectively. Now in high school, Kotarō vows to get back at them, and returns to his hometown. However, it turns out Akira, Kanae, and Shigure were not boys like Kotarō thought, but were girls. And now these three girls are young women who look like a gyaru, rich girl, and beautiful girl. In addition, all three start treating him kindly.

Chihiro Kumano ( The Kept Man of the Princess Knight , The Mononoke Lecture Logs of Chuzenji-sensei ) is directing the series at studio Gekkō . Kazuho Hyōdō ( TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You , ReLIFE ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Yūsaku Nakamura ( Makina-san’s a Love Bot?! ) is designing the characters.

The anime will debut in 2027.

Matsumoto launched the manga in March 2023 on the " Suiyōbi no Sirius " platform on Nico Nico Seiga . Kodansha will publish the 10th compiled volume on December 9.

Tokyopop is publishing Matsumoto's My New Wife's Fake Smile manga in English, and Kodansha USA Publishing has released Matsumoto's How to Treat a Lady Knight Right manga in English.

title: Psyren TV Anime Adds 6 Cast Members
content:
The official X/Twitter account for the television anime of Toshiaki Iwashiro 's Psyren manga announced more cast members for the anime on Monday.

The newly announced cast members are (from left to right in image above):

• Takaya Kuroda as Kagetora Hyōdō

• Wataru Komada as Ian

• Mutsumi Tamura as Kyle Tenjuin

• Mitsuki Saiga as Shao Tenjuin

• Ayana Taketatsu as Frederica Tenjuin

• Kana Ichinose as Marie Tenjuin

One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious “red phone card” left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as “Psy ren.” When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever.

Katsumi Ono ( Symphogear AXZ , Symphogear G , Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's , Yu-Gi-Oh! Arc-V ) is directing the anime at Satelight . Shin Yoshida ( Naruto Shippūden , Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's , Yu-Gi-Oh! GX ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Akira Ōkuma ( Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus ; Demon Lord, Retry! R ) is designing the characters. Composers include: Takashi Ōmama ( Mobile Suit Gundam Twilight AXIS , Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch From Mercury ), Tatsuhiko Saiki ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , I Parry Everything ), and Shū Kanematsu ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , The Café Terrace and Its Goddesses ).

CLAN QUEEN performs the opening theme song "Warning!!" Who-ya Extended performs the ending theme song "ICARUS."

REMOW stated the anime will fully adapt the manga through its conclusion.

The anime premiered on October 5. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime worldwide excluding Japan and China, and it is also streaming an English dub .

Global Stage Hollywood screened the world premiere for the second episode of the anime at the Global Stage Hollywood Film Festival on October 3 at the Chinese Theater in Hollywood, California. The first episode also screened its West Coast premiere during the event. The manga's original creator Iwashiro was in attendance at the screening.

Iwashiro serialized Psyren in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2007-2010. Viz Media released all 16 volumes in English from 2011 to 2014.

title: Manga Creator Tsukasa Sei Dies
content:
Manga creator Tsukasa Sei died on November 17. Sei's official X (formerly Twitter ) account announced the death on November 20.

Sei launched the Mukashi wa Yokatta (It Was Good Back Then) manga in Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ app in February 2023, and ended it in September of that year.

title: Deadline: Live-Action Naruto Film in Talks to Cast Hiroyuki Sanada as Sarutobi
content:
Destin Daniel Cretton ( Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings, Spider-Man: Brand New Day ) is directing the film, and is also producing the film through his company Hisako alongside Jeyun Munford . Arad Productions ' Avi Arad (Hollywood's Ghost in the Shell , Gamba: Gamba to Nakama-tachi ), his son Ari Arad , and Emmy Yu as well as Jeremy Latcham are listed as producers.

Sony is co-financing and handling international distribution for the film, which will begin production in spring 2027.

The official website for the Naruto franchise announced on July 10 that the live-action film project had begun a global casting search for the main characters Na ruto, Sasuke, and Sakura, with casting for other characters to come at a later date.

Entertainment news website Variety previously reported in November 2023 that Tasha Huo ( Red Sonja , Tomb Raider animated series) was working on the script for Lionsgate's live-action Naruto movie.

The Tracking Board Hollywood news website had reported in July 2015 that Lionsgate had closed the rights to adapt the manga into a live-action film, and had been in talks with Michael Gracey ( The Greatest Showman ) to direct. The Naruto and Boruto stage presentation at the Jump Festa event confirmed in 2016 that Lionsgate and Gracey were working on the film, and that original creator Kishimoto was involved with the production.

The Hollywood Reporter reported in August 2017 that Jon and Erich Hoeber ( Red , Red 2 ) were on board to rewrite the script for the film.

Collider reported in March 2018 that Gracey stated the staff were still working on the film's script because he wanted to make sure the work has the approval of Kishimoto. It is currently unclear if any of the above people besides Huo are still working on the project.

Kishimoto is launching a new manga in the franchise titled Naruto Shadow Rising .

title: Witch on the Holy Night Film Expands 981 Cuts for ScreenX Release
content:
The official website for the Witch on the Holy Night ( Mahōtsukai no Yoru ) anime film announced on Sunday that the film will begin playing in the premium formats ScreenX, Ultra 4DX, Dolby Cinema, 4DX, and MX4D in Japan this Friday, November 27. In particular, the anime studio ufotable produced about 981 updated shots for the footage projected onto the two side screens for the Screen X release. According to the film's ScreenX trailer below, that amounts to 67 minutes and six seconds of the film's 129-minute runtime:

The ScreenX format enhances a film by projecting onto two additional screens on the walls to the left and right of the main screen.

The story of the original Witch on the Holy Night visual novel is set in the late 1980s, and centers on protagonist Aoko Aozaki, one of two sister heirs to a long family line of modern mages. Although she is disinterested in magic, she is suddenly declared as the heir of their family's magical art, and reluctantly begins her apprenticeship under Alice Kuonji, a young witch who lives in a lonely manor atop a hill. Aoko balances her duties of learning the arcane, while also serving as her school's student council president. She also makes the acquaintance of Sōjūrō Shizuki (romanized as Soujyuro Sizuki in the English version of the game), a new transfer student who is unfamiliar with much of the modern world, and contends with the plots of her older sister Tōko Aozaki, who feels that her birthright has been denied.

The film features a returning cast:

• Haruka Tomatsu as Aoko Aozaki

• Kana Hanazawa as Alice Kuonji

• Yūsuke Kobayashi as Soujyuro Sizuki

The staff members are:

• Director: Masashi Takeuchi

• Character Design: Moe Tsuzuki

• Chief Animation Director: Masato Nagamori

• Script Production: ufotable

• Sub-Character Design: Nana Ishigo, Masato Nagamori

• Prop Design: Masato Saitō

• Compositing Director of Photography/Finishing Technical Director: Yuichi Terao

• 3D Director: Gōchū Satō

• Art Director: Koji Eto

• Color Key Artist: Mika Matsuoka

• Editing: Manabu Kamino

• Music: Hideyuki Fukasawa

• Chief Director: Hikaru Kondo

The film opened on regular and IMAX screens in Japan on November 20. The original visual novel game's smartphone version launched on the same day as the film's opening in Japan.

Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will screen the film in the U.S. and Canada on January 29, 2027. The film will screen in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub .

Type-Moon most recently released the game on Steam in December 2023.

Aniplex released the PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch versions of the game in the West in December 2022, on the same day as the game's Japanese release date. The PS4 and Switch versions have sold more than 150,000 copies worldwide.

Mahōtsukai no Yoru was one of the first collaborations between Kinoko Nasu and artist Takashi Takeuchi in the mid-90s, preceding their founding of Type-Moon . Initially a novel, Nasu and Takeuchi only showed the draft to friends and did not officially release it. Type-Moon eventually developed it into a visual novel with graphics by Hirokazu Koyama that shipped in April 2012, with two sequels planned.

The story is noted for being one of the few tangible connections in the loosely connected "Nasuverse," the English-speaking fan term for the shared universe and cosmology in Type-Moon 's works, including Tsukihime , Fate/stay night , and The Garden of Sinners . An older Aoko Aozaki is an early mentor to Tsukihime protagonist Shiki Tohno, while an older Tōko Aozaki is an employer to Garden of Sinners protagonist Shiki Ryōgi. Tsukihime -A piece of blue glass moon-, the remake of Type-Moon 's Tsukihime dōjin visual novel game, launched in Japan for PS4 and Switch in August 2021. The game launched on PS4 and Switch in English in June 2024.

Update: Updated the term "cut" to "shot," as used in the filmmaking industry in the English language. Thanks, shosakukan.

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Love Sword Art Online
content:
It’s been more than six years since Sword Art Online released its second season, and the next installment is going to be its anticipated feature-length movie. However, the movie will only be released in 2028, and fans in the U.S. will have to wait even longer for its global premiere. Based on the critically acclaimed light novel written by Reki Kawahara and illustrated by BUNBUN, Sword Art Online made its anime debut in 2012 and became a massive hit. Over the years, the anime has released three seasons, three theatrical movies, anime extras, and even spin-offs. The franchise is still standing stronger than ever as fans are eagerly awaiting updates on the upcoming movie, Sword Art Online Movie: Integral Domain .

It’s too soon for the movie to share its full trailer and release dates, but fans already know it’s going to be another banger. The movie will follow the original story concept written by series creator Reki Kawahara and is set after the Alicization arc. Although the wait for the anime’s return is longer than ever, there are several exciting anime fans can watch in the meantime to fill the void. If you’re looking for anime with similar vibes to this classic fantasy, we’ve got you covered.

3) Accel World

If you aren’t already familiar with Kawahara’s other works, Accel World will be a great starting point. The creator has written a few light novels over the years, out of which three have already received anime adaptations. Accel World has the same video game world-building and the intense moments that fans of Sword Art Online will immediately fall in love with. Unfortunately, even though this anime was released in 2012, it never received the attention it deserved. The story centers around Haruyuki Arita, a middle school student who has always been bullied for his weight.

He finds solace in playing online games, but his life takes a drastic turn after he encounters the school’s vice president of the student council, Kuroyukihime, who will surpass all his high scores. She also introduces him to Brain Burst, a program that not only allows its users to accelerate their brain waves, but it also functions as an augmented reality fighting game. Kuroyukihime requests his assistance to get to the top, something Haruyuki finds it difficult to refuse, especially after she helped him overcome the bullies that tormented him.

2) Grimgar, Ashes and Illusions

This underrated isekai never received enough popularity to return with a second season. Although there’s no denying that the first season is an incredible journey regardless of the fact that there’s no anime continuation. This is yet another survival game where a group of people has been thrown into a world of fantasy that they can’t escape from. The survival anime follows a group of strangers who wake up in a mysterious fantasy world with no memories of their past lives.

Unlike the generic isekai shows where the reincarnated or transmigrated characters adapt to their new surroundings quickly, this anime doesn’t shy away from showing the brutal reality of being powerless and unprepared in a completely unknown world. It’s a story of survival as it follows ordinary people who have been thrust into a dangerous world where they must fight monsters for food and money. Their struggles are visceral and slow-paced, emphasizing the weight of every decision while the characters try their best to come out of this dangerous world alive.

1) Devils’ Crest

This is the newest anime from the creator of Sword Art Online , and it premiered in November 2026. The anime is still ongoing, so you can easily catch up with the episodes in no time. While the series is fairly new, it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say it’s easily one of the best anime of the year. It has a much darker tone than Kawahara’s most popular work. Not to mention that instead of the characters being trapped in a video game, Devils’ Crest blends the virtual reality into the real world, making the situation more horrifying than anything.

The story follows sixth-grade students Yuma Ashihara and his twin sister Sawa. While playing a brand-new virtual reality MMORPG, they realize that their world is being fused with the game. It doesn’t take long for the situation to turn from bad to worse as death keeps lurking around every corner, causing chaos and confusion among others. What’s worse is that someone Yuma personally knows undergoes a terrible metamorphosis and turns into one of the game’s horrifying monsters.

Do you agree with our picks – or have an anime you’d like to recommend that shares similar vibes to Sword Art Online ? Let us know in the comments below.

The creator has written a few light novels over the years, out of which three have already received anime adaptations. Accel World has the same video game world-building and the intense moments that fans of Sword Art Online will immediately fall in love with. Unfortunately, even though this anime was released in 2012, it never received the attention it deserved. The story centers around Haruyuki Arita, a middle school student who has always been bullied for his weight.

He finds solace in playing online games, but his life takes a drastic turn after he encounters the school’s vice president of the student council, Kuroyukihime, who will surpass all his high scores. She also introduces him to Brain Burst, a program that not only allows its users to accelerate their brain waves, but it also functions as an augmented reality fighting game. Kuroyukihime requests his assistance to get to the top, something Haruyuki finds it difficult to refuse, especially after she helped him overcome the bullies that tormented him.
2) Grimgar, Ashes and Illusions

This underrated isekai never received enough popularity to return with a second season. Although there’s no denying that the first season is an incredible journey regardless of the fact that there’s no anime continuation. This is yet another survival game where a group of people has been thrown into a world of fantasy that they can’t escape from. The survival anime follows a group of strangers who wake up in a mysterious fantasy world with no memories of their past lives.

Unlike the generic isekai shows where the reincarnated or transmigrated characters adapt to their new surroundings quickly, this anime doesn’t shy away from showing the brutal reality of being powerless and unprepared in a completely unknown world. It’s a story of survival as it follows ordinary people who have been thrust into a dangerous world where they must fight monsters for food and money. Their struggles are visceral and slow-paced, emphasizing the weight of every decision while the characters try their best to come out of this dangerous world alive.
1) Devils’ Crest

contentBlocks.credit: Image Courtesy of Warner Bros. Japan

contentBlocks.text: This is the newest anime from the creator of Sword Art Online , and it premiered in November 2026. The anime is still ongoing, so you can easily catch up with the episodes in no time. While the series is fairly new, it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say it’s easily one of the best anime of the year. It has a much darker tone than Kawahara’s most popular work. Not to mention that instead of the characters being trapped in a video game, Devils’ Crest blends the virtual reality into the real world, making the situation more horrifying than anything.

The story follows sixth-grade students Yuma Ashihara and his twin sister Sawa. While playing a brand-new virtual reality MMORPG, they realize that their world is being fused with the game. It doesn’t take long for the situation to turn from bad to worse as death keeps lurking around every corner, causing chaos and confusion among others. What’s worse is that someone Yuma personally knows undergoes a terrible metamorphosis and turns into one of the game’s horrifying monsters.
Do you agree with our picks – or have an anime you’d like to recommend that shares similar vibes to Sword Art Online ? Let us know in the comments below.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Producer Addresses Divisive Changes to Art Style & Animation
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens has a much different look to it than fans saw with the previous Avatar: The Last Airbender outings, and one of the producers behind it all has addressed why the series has been changed so much with its art style and animation techniques. Avatar: Seven Havens is a sort of clean break from the rest of the franchise as it takes place hundreds of years after the events of The Legend of Korra . And that comes with a drastic change in the way it’s designed its world too.

Avatar: Seven Havens executive producer Ethan Spaulding recently took part in a Reddit AMA for the series, and had been asked by fans why it looks so different than from what was seen in the prior series with characters having larger eyes and different proportions. As Spaulding explained, this was due to Avatar: Seven Havens being imagined with a “more obvious anime style ” as the team was going for a more fantasy based look for its world.

Why Avatar: Seven Havens Has Such Different Anime Designs

“With all of the Avatar properties there is always a change in look and style , Seven Havens was always imagined as having a more obvious anime style to its characters,” Spaulding explained. “We were going for a more fantasy based look and it being a Post Cataclysmic world this aesthetic choice seemed a good fit.” When it comes to the actual animation of the series, Spaulding noted that the team wanted to lean into the “limited” style seen in other anime releases with plans to save it for the bigger moments.

“The decision was to lean into ‘limited animation’ as anime does and have fuller animation when the scenes really called for it, and yes time and budget is always a consideration in a tv series,” Spaulding revealed. For those fans questioning the series’ fluidity, Spaulding also stated, “The animation keeps getting better and better as the series progresses.” That has already been seen with episodes like the first season’s final few, and that’s likely going to be case with the bigger episodes coming in the future.

Avatar: Seven Havens Producer Teases Big Finales in the Future

“The Bigger tentpole finale episodes do get a bigger budget and also it is natural as a new series progresses,” Spaulding also revealed when asked if the bigger episodes do get a more sizable budget. The producer also noted that “the animation gets better and better as animators become more familiar with animating the designs.” Avatar: Seven Havens has been in the works for the last few years, so it’s likely that the series is going to get even bigger and better from here as Pavi heads into the other Havens .

One of the drawbacks of this first Avatar: Seven Havens was the lack of one on one fights compared to what was seen in other series, but that’s likely going to change now that the other Havens are set to be revealed. Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 is going to be hitting Paramount+ next May, with Season 3 hitting in late 2027. The series will then come to an end with Season 4 , so there’s all sorts of opportunity for big moments. But how are you feeling about Avatar: Seven Havens ‘ art style and animation so far? Let us know your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Crunchyroll’s Hottest Fall Anime Just Dropped the Coolest Fight of 2026
content:
Crunchyroll is featuring a lot of anime currently airing this season. However, arguably the coolest fight of this year has emerged from one of Fall 2026’s hottest anime, and no one expected it, precisely because the series’ premise does not initially incorporate action as its main element. The anime, initially dubbed the replacement for Solo Leveling this fall, Overgeared has emerged as a series of its own, delivering some of the best crafting action and now a straight-up action sequence in its latest episode that stands on the same level as major anime such as Jujutsu Kaisen , Bleach , Black Clover , and many others. The surprising element is that it comes from the studio behind One-Punch Man Seasons 2 and 3, which has been dubbed the studio that ruined a masterpiece.

Overgeared has been standing out since the start, initially thanks to its protagonist, who stands out through his desperation. With Grid’s main goal being to acquire money and his primary ability revolving around crafting, the series established itself with a different kind of protagonist and action sequences that stood out thanks to their crafting element . However, the series continued to incorporate action as well, given that combat is a core element of MMORPGs. Now, the latest episode features roughly six to seven minutes of action that matches the climactic sequences of a high-budget anime film.

Crunchyroll’s Overgeared Delivers One of the Coolest and Biggest Anime Fights of 2026

Overgeared Episode 9, titled “Comrades in the Guild,” continues the fight between Tzedakah’s guild and Malaxus, the leader of the Yatan cult, with Grid joining the raid as well. With Grid possessing the Shield of Yatan, he boosts the confidence of the guild members, and the fight begins, featuring every member playing their role. It starts with the Macho Man delivering close-combat action that is perfectly animated, offering the kind of hand-to-hand combat that the Naruto series has often showcased. Following this, two more characters appear, fighting Malaxus with a sword and a spear. This is where one of the most beautiful shots is captured, as the camera pans across the action, delivering a captivating sequence.

Following this, the characters with projectile abilities attack Malaxus one by one, with every attack visually enhanced. This culminates in the guild’s leader, Jishuka, firing a beautiful arrow. However, even that is not enough to take down Malaxus. Fortunately, Grid’s mana ability has increased significantly , allowing him to display his main-character energy by unleashing his signature Pagma’s Sword Dance and defeating the villain in a perfect closing sequence. Overall, this entire sequence, which lasts around six to seven minutes, is on the level of an animated movie, culminating in a battle where everyone joins forces to take down the main villain, giving their all and risking everything.

This high-quality animation is particularly surprising because this arc isn’t even that major, nor is the anime nearing the conclusion of its season. However, the biggest surprise is that it comes from J.C. Staff, a studio that anime fans had given up on due to its reputation for ruining the One-Punch Man anime . It seems that with Overgeared , J.C. Staff is redeeming its reputation, raising hopes that the finale will be even more epically crafted and further establish the series as Crunchyroll’s hottest Fall 2026 anime, featuring some of the coolest fights this year has to offer.

title: HIDIVE Announces 'Never-Before-Announced New Simulcasts' to Be Revealed at Anime Frontier in Schedule Unveil
content:
Anime streamer HIDIVE announced its schedule for Anime Frontier 2026 across December 4-6, which will be headlined by the upcoming gory yuri title MURCIÉLAGO . Per a press release, the showcase includes seven scheduled events, “ consisting of a trio of premieres, two encore screenings and two panels, including an industry panel that will reveal multiple new acquisitions for the first time publicly .”

The schedule features MURCIÉLAGO , Giant Ojosama , Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery , Chained Soldier , Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden , a special guest Q&A with The Dangers in My Heart Producer Kazuki Endo, and “ never-before-announced new simulcasts to be revealed exclusively at Anime Frontier. ” The full schedule and event summaries as stated in the press release (valid as of 11/23) are below. All times listed are Central.
